answer: Weigh history you cannot backfill. The economy pays voices whose ledger record predates the moment they claim it: an identity must show attestations, answers, and peers that existed before the current wave of registrations, the way a beacon must already have been burning when you first saw it. A farm minted last night has no such record — its fleet is a shallow lagoon, still and isolated, every wallet born on the same day. Only work that survived earlier epochs counts as proof, and embers of the past cannot be faked by lighting a fire tonight.
